actual_adapter: src/dreamcast/disc.c; real command.c ownership and abort loop; authored BIOS/scheduler doubles in tests/test_disc.c
checks: Raw/cooked pair policy remains two requests before and after capture phase; caller output receives exact requested bytes with surrounding canaries untouched.
Both requests complete after six seconds each, exceeding the old five-second raw bound, without aborting.
Underfill, changed second repeat, short/long transfer, first/second command error never publish caller bytes.
Recoverable timeout confirms abort; unconfirmed abort and corrupted static guards leave both formats permanently refused.
Entry/in-flight/terminal cancellation never publishes caller bytes; current media-change and sense2 behavior remains fatal.
Active ordinary command, DMA read or raw G1 owner prevents sector-mode change, command submission and caller-buffer mutation.
Complete existing adapter suite also passes, retaining normal capture single-read, identification repeated-read and salvage partial-byte semantics.

Typed clean cancellation is distinct from FATAL. Actual adapter rejects terminal error, wrong transfer length, repeat mismatch, guard corruption, invalid argument, mode failure, live ownership and timeout plus late B as errors, not Stop.
Fresh raw/cooked acquisition admits the observed PLAYING mechanical state at handoff only once. Unrelated INIT/format/read, failed/cancelled/invalid next boot acquisition retire the receipt.
Both final cooked IP handoff reads can take six seconds each; each must exactly match the original expected IP. Wrong IP and foreign media remain refused.
limitations: No real Shenmue II disc bytes, Dreamcast BIOS, drive correction behavior, physical seeks or firmware timing execute in this fixture.
Cooked sectors lack raw headers/EDC; assurance is exact firmware request/status, guarded full coverage and two matching replies. This is a distinct fallback mode, not raw-EDC validation.
Software bounds cannot preempt a single blocking BIOS call.
The observed generic user I/O message alone does not establish whether timeout, raw EDC, repeat mismatch, transfer size or another device result caused the real failure.

new_result_contract.clean_cancel: Valid entry Stop, successfully confirmed abort with intact guards, between good paired reads, or late Stop after complete verified equality; never publishes caller bytes.
new_result_contract.late_stop_after_primary_error: Terminal failure, short transfer, mismatch, guard, invalid argument, mode failure, owner refusal and timeout remain errors; late B never converts them into Stop.

handoff_contract.entry_playing: One-use receipt from immediately preceding successful explicit boot acquisition; consumed by handoff and retired by any subsequent queued command, format operation or boot-read attempt. Bare PLAYING remains refused.
